text:
anya: Quick sync  finalizing rollout strategy for routes.payment.v2. This is a customer-driven launch; we need per-tenant opt-ins, ops watch windows, and clear auto-rollback rules.
kevin: Agreed. Plan to start canary in a single AZ (us-west-2) then broaden regionally.
anya: Draft 3-phase plan: phase A: canary us-west-2 1% for 60m. phase B: warmup us-west-2 + us-east-1 at 5% for 6h. phase C: staged ramp to 25% then target 100% over 48h if metrics stable.
marcus: Abort criteria: auto-rollback if error_rate >= 2x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency increase >200ms for 5m. Immediate rollback if any customer-visible 5xx spike >0.5% of requests.
jordan: For A/B we need payment_success_rate and downstream conversion delta. Block moving beyond 25% until 95% CI on primary metric passes.
linda: Sales asks: platinum customers want early opt-in. We should support per-tenant opt-in flags and a 24h blackout opt-out window.
anya: We'll keep default OFF and enable an early-adopter cohort via per-tenant flag.
kevin: Feature-flag example (pseudopayload): ```
{"flag":"routes.payment.v2_enabled","strategies":[{"scope":"region","region":"us-west-2","pct":1},{"scope":"tenant","tenant_id":"T-PLAT-42","pct":100}],"kill_conditions":{"error_rate_mult":2.0,"p95_ms":200}}
```
marcus: Ops: request two 2-hour watch windows in week1 (09:00-11:00 PT, 14:00-16:00 PT). Pager escalation to oncall and product runbook link. Auto-postmortem trigger if rollback occurs.
anya: I'll create runbook RB-2026-58 and list approvers for each window.
kevin: Fallback behavior: on auto-rollback route traffic to routes.payment.v1 and mark the flag as "failed-canary" to prevent automated re-roll for 24h.
jordan: Also run a 2-week 15% A/B for non-payment flows (search/cart) to catch downstream regressions. Tag all experiment telemetry.
linda: Add a manual "pause" button in admin console for customers to opt-out immediately; product+security sign-off required.
marcus: Preflight checklist: smoke tests pass; dashboards created (error_rate, p50/p95/p99, success_rate); alerts mapped to runbook; rollout inhibit if infra CPU >80%.
anya: Gate before phase B: errors <= baseline, p95 <=1.2x baseline, no customer escalations, experiment telemetry nominal.
kevin: Timeline recap: Day0 canary 1h; Day0-1 warmup 6h; Day1-3 staged to 25%; Day3-5 full ramp if stable.
anya: Owners: ops owns canary decisions; product+eng own regional ramp approvals. Approvers will be in RB-2026-58.
linda: I'll deliver platinum CSV by EOD.
jordan: I'll publish the experiment dashboard and implement a CI check to block >25% if sample size insufficient.
marcus: I'll add automation to flip the flag and post to #incidents via deploy-bot when kill_conditions fire.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback configured. Will post state changes to channel and tag oncall. :robot_face: 
anya: Thanks team. Posting this as canonical plan. Ping me in-thread for any updates. :white_check_mark:
